calls.statement: SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year FROM dim_date ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT * FROM ref_fiscal_calendar 
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
ORDER BY fiscal_period
